annotations.title: Child benefits paid by ZUS: 800 plus and Aktywny Rodzic

description: Use for how many children get 800 plus or Aktywny Rodzic (babciowe, nursery, at home) and how much ZUS pays, in Poland, by voivodeship and by municipality (gmina). Give ZUS as the source. Monthly statistics of ZUS (Polish Social Insurance Institution) on the child benefit 800 plus (świadczenie wychowawcze) and the three Aktywny Rodzic benefits (aktywni rodzice w pracy - working parents and aktywnie w domu - at home, both for children aged 12-35 months; aktywnie w żłobku - nursery fee): benefits paid in the latest month with year-on-year change, PLN paid in the month and since January, average payment, children paid, 800 plus applications, granted and refusals since January, the share of each Aktywny Rodzic variant in Poland and in a chosen voivodeship, and the finwire index finwire_child_benefits_payout (PLN billion paid in the month for all four benefits). For the amount of 800 plus, deadlines and how much it grows when saved see the finwire.pl page linked in the result.

gmina.description: Optional municipality (gmina) name in Polish, diacritics optional (e.g. "szczecin", "lodz"), or TERYT code; returns up to 10 matches with 800 plus per 1000 residents and Aktywny Rodzic shares.

history.description: Number of past months of the index in the summary, default 12.

voivodeship.description: Optional voivodeship name in Polish (e.g. "mazowieckie") or TERYT code (e.g. "14").
